slug: 2024-07-15 World Bank identifies priority actions for DPI in Equatorial Guinea

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that the World Bank diagnostic recommends a national interoperability framework for Equatorial Guinea, describing it as currently absent; the date is the article's published date, 2024-07-15.

note: Press account of a World Bank working week on the digital economy strategy and telecom legal framework; it names no interoperability framework and no data-exchange rule.
Handover of the National Development Agency; says ministries share little information with it, but names no interoperability framework or exchange system.

slug: 2024-06-25 Equatorial Guinea Digital Economy Country Diagnostic - Bridging the Gaps
note: Summary page of the World Bank diagnostic; it says nothing on interoperability or data exchange.

facts.fact: The World Bank's Equatorial Guinea Digital Economy Diagnostic states that the government has no national interoperability framework, no government enterprise architecture framework and no interoperability platform or data exchange layer, and recommends introducing a framework; no event date is given, so the document's published date of 2024-01-01 is used.
